_comment: Native connector coverage registry. Must equal core/conan/coverage.cpp (tests/drift_test.py). 'status' is evidence (live-supported needs MCP plus client evidence); 'implementation' says whether native code exists ('native') or the action still answers a structured not-ported error ('pending').

statusLegend.live-supported: Native code exists and was proven live through Takaro with MCP and client evidence.
statusLegend.schema-fallback: Answers the schema-valid empty DTO Takaro requires because the data does not exist for this game.
statusLegend.unsupported: Answers a structured error because neither the game nor Takaro can back it.
statusLegend.pending: Native code is missing or not yet proven live; transitional, must be gone before release.

getPlayer.responseShape: public Takaro player DTO or null
getPlayer.verification: Live 2026-10-03: MCP commandTrigger -> getPlayer answered online, and again with the client on the main menu (last record), no Takaro DTO error (El-Limon evidence native-stage2/L2a)
getPlayer.reason: Same snapshot as getPlayers; an offline player answers the last record seen in this process, else a minimal record from the requested id (Takaro rejects every no-player answer).

getPlayers.verification: Live 2026-10-03 rig 349 (native l2a, bridge stopped): MCP gameserverGetPlayers -> {gameId 76561198000735875, name Limon#67642, steamId, platformId, ip 192.168.129.15, ping}; client Player List shows werwerwer / Limon#67642 (El-Limon evidence native-stage2/L2a)
getPlayers.reason: Worker-thread safe self-reads (process_vm_readv): GameStateBase.PlayerArray -> PlayerState -> Owner controller; gameId = Steam64 from PlayerState.UniqueID (conan/identity, shared by every action and event; UserIDFromURLOptions only as a fallback), name PlayerNamePrivate, ip SavedNetworkAddress, ping ExactPing (PlayerState+824, checked once against GetPingInMilliseconds). No RCON.

getPlayerLocation.responseShape: { x: number, y: number, z: number }
getPlayerLocation.verification: Live 2026-10-03: MCP trackingGetPlayerMovementHistory equals K2_GetActorLocation (probe) to the cm, follows a 68 m walk, and projects onto the client map arrow within 4 px (El-Limon evidence native-stage2/L2a)
getPlayerLocation.reason: Worker read: Controller.Pawn -> RootComponent -> RelativeLocation, or ComponentToWorld (+0x210, checked against K2_GetActorLocation) when attached to a mount; the last known position while dead/offline.

getPlayerInventory.verification: Live 2026-10-03: MCP playerongameserverSearch inventory = client inventory screen (Stone 7, Plant Fiber 28, Stone Hatchet, Stone Pick, Stone Sword); durability quality equals GetFloatStat (0/100 -> 0, 37.5/180 -> 21); fists dropped; same after a rejoin (El-Limon evidence native-stage2/L2a)
getPlayerInventory.reason: Worker read of the backpack, hotbar and equipment ItemInventory lists (torn-read checked, game-thread copy as fallback); stack and durability from the GameItem stat arrays (checked against GetIntStat/GetFloatStat); fist templates 51204/51205 dropped; amounts summed per code and durability %.

giveItem.verification: Live 2026-10-03 rig 349 (El-Limon evidence native-stage2/L2b): MCP gameserverGiveItem Stone x1500 -> 2 AddItemTemplate stacks, 1000 + 500 in the client inventory; template id 10001 x7 after a death/respawn; x3 after the Steam64 fix; unknown code refused in the connector (Takaro's giveItem endpoint answers {} even then)
giveItem.reason: ItemInventory.AddItemTemplate on ConanCharacter.GetBackpackInventory, one stack per call, looped until the amount is given and read back with GetNumberOfItemsByTemplate. The item code is a template id or an ItemNameToTemplateID row name (13 tables, 8,117 codes); unknown codes are refused. Quality is ignored (Conan items have no quality tier).

listItems.responseShape: Takaro item DTO array with display names
listItems.verification: Live 2026-10-03: Takaro syncItems -> 7521 rows; MCP itemSearch samples carry display names (Giant Symbol, Precepts of Zath, Reptilian Tasset (#52019)); inventory names match the client screen (El-Limon evidence native-stage2/L2a)
listItems.reason: /Game/Items/ItemTable rows with their localised names (worker FText decode checked against Conv_TextToString), codes from ItemNameToTemplateID; XX_/dev/test rows dropped, duplicate names get ' (#templateId)'. Built once per process.

listEntities.responseShape: Takaro entity DTO array with display names
listEntities.verification: Live 2026-10-03: Takaro syncEntities -> 6003 rows, MCP entitySearch samples carry display names; no client-side entity name compare in lane L2a yet
listEntities.reason: /Game/Systems/SpawnTable/SpawnDataTable rows: code = row name (also ConanCharacter.SourceSpawnTable on live NPCs), localised name, NPC class only in metadata. Built once per process.

listLocations.verification: Live 2026-10-03: 255 Exiled Lands markers built in-process; the player stood 82 m from marker 'The Broken Highway' on the paved road (client). Takaro never requested listLocations and the MCP has no locations tool, so no MCP proof yet
listLocations.reason: /Game/Systems/Map/MapMarkers_ConanSandbox named places of the loaded map with world coordinates and discovery radius; retried until the table is loaded.

executeConsoleCommand.verification: Live 2026-10-03 rig 349: MCP gameserverExecuteCommand 'log LogTemp Verbose' (engine console) and 'WhatsMyId' (player console) return the server's own output lines as rawResult; admin-only 'SpawnItem 12001 3' as a non-admin put 3 Plant Fiber in the client inventory; 'listplayers' refused
executeConsoleCommand.reason: KismetSystemLibrary.ExecuteConsoleCommand in the first online player's console with the admin flag set and restored inside one game-thread job (the engine console when nobody is online). rawResult = the server log lines tagged with that frame (Conan commands answer through the log; unrelated lines of the same frame can appear). exit/quit and the RCON verbs (listplayers, kickplayer, banplayer, unbanplayer, listbans, broadcast, shutdown) are refused with the Takaro action to use.

sendMessage.verification: Live 2026-10-03 on rig 349 (bridge stopped): MCP gameserverSendMessage global and directed (opts.recipient.gameId + senderNameOverride) -> native log delivered=1 each, both lines in the client chat (El-Limon evidence native-stage2/L1)
sendMessage.reason: ClientReceiveChatMessage on each online ConanPlayerController through ProcessEvent on the game thread; global, or directed by Steam64 / character name.

teleportPlayer.verification: Live 2026-10-03 rig 349: MCP gameserverTeleportPlayer to Riverwatch Camp and to two road positions; server log TeleportPlayerServer + HandleTeleportStreamingDone, read-back xy distance 0, client screenshots at each place
teleportPlayer.reason: ConanPlayerController.TeleportPlayerServer (RunCheatCheck=false, SnapToGround=true), Conan's own teleport with area streaming and loading screen; read back with K2_GetActorLocation (x/y within 300 units; z snaps to the ground).

testReachability.verification: Live 2026-10-03: MCP gameserverTestReachabilityForId -> {connectable:true, reason:null} from the native library with the bridge stopped; unknown-build path covered by tests/so_test.py
testReachability.reason: In-process: connectable when the server build is pinned and the ProcessEvent hook is installed; an unknown build answers connectable=false with the reason.

kickPlayer.verification: Live 2026-10-03 rig 349: MCP gameserverKickPlayer -> client back at the main menu, server log Player disconnected within 0.3 s, connector confirmed the player left the online list (twice, before and after the Steam64 fix)
kickPlayer.reason: PlayerController.ClientReturnToMainMenuWithTextReason with the reason (FText from KismetTextLibrary.Conv_StringToText); succeeds only once the player has left the online list. The client returns to the menu without showing the reason text.

banPlayer.verification: Live 2026-10-03 rig 349: offline ban then rejoin -> kicked 2.6 s after Join succeeded (K2_PostLogin hook + sweep); online timed ban -> kicked at once, lifted by the connector at expiresAt, rejoin allowed
banPlayer.reason: Connector ban list keyed by Steam64 in Saved/Config/Takaro/bans.json (atomic write), online and offline, permanent or timed (expiresAt); enforced by kicks after K2_PostLogin and a sweep over the online players. Conan's own blacklist cannot hold offline or timed bans and is not touched.

unbanPlayer.verification: Live 2026-10-03 rig 349: MCP gameserverUnbanPlayer (player offline) -> bans.json empty, rejoin succeeded and stayed in game
unbanPlayer.reason: Removes the Steam64 from the connector ban list (works offline). Timed bans are lifted by the connector itself at expiry (Takaro sends no unban).

listBans.verification: Live 2026-10-03 rig 349: MCP gameserverListBans with a timed ban (expiresAt), a permanent ban (null) and empty
listBans.reason: The active entries of the connector ban list with player, reason and expiresAt. Takaro sends no name with an offline ban, so the name falls back to the Steam64.

shutdown.verification: Live 2026-10-03 rig 349: MCP gameserverShutdown -> '[Server]: The server shuts down in 1 minute / 30 / 10 / 5..2 seconds' in the client chat, then FUnixPlatformMisc::RequestExit(0, UGameEngine::HandleExitCommand), client 'Connection lost', LogExit: Exiting and the container exited with code 0 three minutes later
shutdown.reason: Answers first, then a chat countdown (TAKARO_CONAN_SHUTDOWN_SECONDS, default 60), then the engine's graceful exit: the console command 'exit' through KismetSystemLibrary.ExecuteConsoleCommand in the admin-context console job. No signature pin. The server needs about three minutes to unload after the exit.

getMapInfo.responseShape: { enabled: false, mapBlockSize: 0, maxZoom: 0, mapSizeX: 0, mapSizeY: 0, mapSizeZ: 0 }
getMapInfo.reason: Hosted Takaro shows no map tiles for Generic servers; answers the disabled MapInfo DTO Takaro validates.

getMapTile.verification: MCP gameserverGetMapTile returns the structured error
getMapTile.reason: Hosted Takaro shows no map tiles for Generic servers; no tile renderer exists for Conan.

player-connected.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); nothing is emitted for it. Planned: K2_PostLogin or a PlayerArray diff.

player-disconnected.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); nothing is emitted for it. Planned: K2_OnLogout or a PlayerArray diff.

chat-message.reason: Not ported to the native connector yet (stage 2 Phase 2); nothing is emitted for it. Planned: ServerSendChatMessage in the detour (proven hook point).

log.reason: Today only the connector's own critical notices (an unsupported server build) are sent as log events; the in-process server log tail is Phase 2.
